big_case.notes: Pro se paid certiorari petition from an 8-page nonprecedential Federal Circuit affirmance of a jurisdictional MSPB dismissal over a single former employee's 2015 hazardous-duty-pay supplement and position description. Respondent waived response, zero amici participated, no circuit split was presented, and the Court denied certiorari at first conference without dissent; only the abstract WPEA statutory question in QP2 gives it trace significance above zero.
